notes.title: Lost in memory update 2.4
notes.content:
I was informed of a big bug in lost in memory where you can go through walls by pausing the game so I fixed that and use this as an opportunity to fix other things I'm more confident in dealing with now.

-Fixed the wall pausing bug.-

-Fixed directional idling animation with controller input with joystick.-

-Changed the games text font to something more appropriate.-

-Switching out memories will now automatically close the pause menu for you.-

-Improved the animation for using the scalpel memory, the maid memory and switching memories.-

-And some smaller fixes-

notes.title: Lost in memory update V2.1
notes.content:
-Updated controller controls so that "A" is interact instead of "X" for better control feel.
-"X" is now the memory Using button.
-Fixed the bug were if you pause the game well a text box is open the game soft locks.

notes.title: Lost in memory UPDATE Ver2.0 Flesh and mind is out now!
notes.content:
Lost in memory UPDATE Ver2.0 Flesh and mind 
This update includes

-Three new endings.
   The guilt ending.
   The Shut in ending.
   The killer ending.
-New areas to explore.
    bunny area.
    rose area.
    Mars planet.
    An expansion to the reflection area.
    Forest secret area. 
    City secret area. 
    Inverted mansion.
    Space secret area. 
-The world will now change depending on how many memories collected.
-More interactions with characters.
-New collectibles to find.
-New secrets around the world.
-New abilities to use.
   The scalpel memory can be used to attack.
-Controller support improved
   moved some buttons for convenience.
   Add D-pad for movement.
-Some memories have been moved.
-And various bug fixes.
